facts.value_text: Micron was reducing DRAM and NAND wafer starts by approximately 20% versus fiscal Q4 2022.
facts.statistical_scope: Micron DRAM + NAND wafer starts versus fiscal Q4 2022

metadata.onset_guard: The issuer wording establishes that the reduction was current by the November 16 announcement; it does not establish an earlier exact onset date.
metadata.comparability_guard: Do not compare this 20% wafer-start reduction numerically with SK hynix's >50% investment guidance or Samsung's unspecified certain-product production-cut plan.

facts.value_text: Samsung reported that PC and mobile demand improved in Q3 2023 with increasing high-density DRAM and NAND adoption and completion of customer inventory adjustments.
facts.statistical_scope: Samsung-reported PC/mobile DRAM+NAND demand and customer inventory adjustments in Q3 2023

metadata.mechanism_text: increasing adoption of high-density products and completion of customer inventory adjustments
metadata.scope_guard: This is a scoped Q3 PC/mobile observation, not proof that every memory end-market recovered.
metadata.outcome_guard: Comparison with Samsung's April broad 2H recovery forecast requires an explicit semantic relation; do not infer direct realization from topical similarity.
